steps.content: The attackers utter their final cries, pulverized by the battle shield. Soon, a cleaning team arrives quickly with counter-Mania purifiers to carefully clean up the mess.
All the enemies have been wiped out. They were all monsters formed by Mania contaminants. Rahu noticed the Sinner who attacked Shalom earlier were not among them.
She walks up to the sheriff who was initially attacked. He's still unconscious. Just as Rahu raises her hand to "wake him up," she smells the strange fragrance again—this time, from the man's wound.
Frowning, she quickly peels off the man's clothes and finds something unexpected...
There is a rose under a bottle of <color=#fb9259>perfume</color>. Neither seems to belong to this man.
These are probably the "signals" the assassins left her, the key lead to the rest of the information.
And the door sealing these secrets is most likely the <color=#fb9259>Flowery Scroll</color> left behind by the assassin earlier today.
